segments.speaker: c0000:A
segments.text: DM: Last session you arrived in Reedhaven. Tonight you are still at the gate.

segments.speaker: c0000:B
segments.text: Mira: We could steal the key. No, I ask the guard for help instead.

segments.speaker: c0000:A
segments.text: DM: The guard lends Mira the brass key. She says the tower is empty, but you have not checked that.

segments.speaker: c0000:B
segments.text: Mira: Tomorrow we should go to the tower. For now we wait here at the gate.
